title: acwf-world-heavyweight
label: "Iceman" Greg Smith
note: Attacks both Randy Sheridan and the special-referee Icepick after defending, 5 January 1997; loses the title before September 1997 and publicly blames a UWF wrestler on air. The belt is still seen in an ACWF duffel bag on a UWF card, 3 September 1997, days before the fed's own closure -- no successor is named in the held record.
